instructions:
1. Set up on the 45 degree bench with your feet in the footrests and one thigh against the pad.
2. Place one hand behind your head and the other on your waist.
3. Bend your knee and bring your opposite elbow toward it, twisting your torso.
4. Return to the start. Repeat.
tips:
1. Twist from your core, not your neck.
2. Keep your hips pressed into the pad.
3. Move slowly and under control.

instructions:
1. Set your feet in the footrests and press your thighs against the pad.
2. Cross your arms over your chest and bend forward at the hips.
3. Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
4. Lower under control. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stop at a straight line; do not overextend the lower back.
2. Drive the movement with your glutes and lower back.
3. Keep your neck neutral.
4. Move slowly, no swinging.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to 90 degrees and arms overhead.
2. Lift your upper back and reach your arms forward toward your heels.
3. Hold briefly.
4. Lower under control. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press your lower back into the floor.
2. Lift with your abs, not your neck.
3. Keep the movement slow and controlled.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and hands in fists.
2. Raise one knee while punching the opposite arm overhead.
3. Lower and switch sides, raising the other knee and punching the other arm.
4. Keep a steady rhythm. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core tight for balance.
2. Drive your knee up to hip height.
3. Exhale as you punch.

instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
2. Extend your right arm and left leg until level with your body.
3. Hold briefly, then return to the plank.
4. Extend your left arm and right leg. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips square; do not let them rotate.
2. Brace your core so your hips do not sag.
3. Move slowly and under control.
